sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: catechin content adds real upside. That gives it a useful compound story beyond the near-empty nutrition label. Strong polyphenol reputation. The core appeal of green tea lives in its compounds and effects rather than classic nutrition composition. Nearly zero-calorie daily use. A huge practical advantage in a category judged more by effect than macros.
